claims.title: Covalent packet repair trades wrong-partner access against multivalent clearance and discarded correct links

quoted_fields.interface: Actual registered reactive handles, constant intended/wrong hazards or their explicitly bounded spatial alternative; for reset, independent identical per-edge success, no wrong bonds/damage, complete unrooted-island clearance and retained rooted product in the original register. Multivalent clearance assumes independent arms and an absorbing wash sink. These are model premises, not demonstrated CuAAC reset capabilities.
quoted_fields.failure: This differs from N992's imine checkpoint and does not supersede its reader/reset obstructions. Root connectivity, full mass and end identifiers do not certify sequence: ((m-1)!)^2 alternating orders share those observations for2m distinct monomers with fixed endpoint types/identities. That count does not imply the alternatives occur. Irreversible wrong rooted bonds pass a connectivity filter. The quadratic race law requires all-to-all constant rates; bounded access is a different and favorable interface. Packet isolation, reliable fusion/root removal, preserved recognition adapters and repeated re-registration remain unacquired. Cleaving coding adapters can destroy positional information needed for another retry. Source-cited component chemistry is not independently reverified, and reported simulations are not replayed.

claims.title: Preanchored one-hit weld models change shared-window scaling but retain contact and load-survival gates

quoted_fields.interface: Actual old/new contact and a mechanically effective preanchor; fixed positive graft/shutdown rates; Poisson candidate count and independent candidate outcomes conditional on the common window. The product a*eta*theta*S must represent justified association, donor retention, old-side targeting and later individual service survival, distinct from shared regional delamination. Single-end mass accounting requires one usable terminus per chain and comparable end kinetics.
quoted_fields.failure: Earlier two-hit/time-floor/contact results remain valid at their own interfaces. Cotton cellulose-I/II activity ratios cannot supply a native wet bacterial-interface rate. AFM adhesion energy is not bulk strength. Shared association loss cannot be folded into independent service survival. The reported hybrid221-versus332 reaction-site optimum remains source-reported: astra_xh2_hybrid_weld_test.py is unavailable, so its optimization/stochastic validation is not accepted. Reaction-site counts are not equal mass, energy or manufacture costs. Source-cited biochemical precedents are not newly primary-validated; correct xyloglucan production, sustained association and donor-safe wet load transfer remain unacquired.
